messages:
Maria Gomez: Heads-up — AMX Solutions asked us to validate their SoC perf/W and throughput for a marketplace listing. They want an official Redwood-verified number + runbook. Can we align on KPIs and a short run plan?
Jake Turner: Sounds good. Scope? single model + weights, or multiple variants? target seq len and concurrency?
Maria Gomez: They want 13B and 30B variants, seq len 512 and 2048, and two profiles: latency-SLA (p95 < 250ms for 512) and sustained throughput. Also need power measurement (wall) for perf/W.
Oliver Chen: For kernel tuning we should capture: fused-attn on/off, kv-cache behavior, and cuBLAS vs custom kernels. Also need firmware/drivers versions from AMX.
Jake Turner: Proposed run command for bench harness (rough):
```
bench-run \
  --model amx-13b-q4 \
  --seq-len 2048 \
  --concurrency 16 \
  --duration 900 \
  --power-sensor /dev/ttyUSB0 \
  --telemetry s3://redwood-bench/amx/1932456789/
```
Use both perf and power sensors, and include per-token latency histogram.
HW Bench Bot: dry-run report uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/amx/1932456789/dry-run-2026-10-03.json — baseline (no kernel tweaks): avg 118 tok/s, avg power 312W -> 0.378 tok/J. See brief log snippet below.
```
summary: tok/s=118, p95lat=290ms (@512 reduced), power_avg=312W
notes: OOM at concurrency 24 on 30B unless kv-evict enabled
```
Susan Park: Marketplace gating note — partner listing requires a documented benchmark procedure + an ops playbook (how to reproduce, fallbacks, kernel versions). They also want a co-branded perf claim approval process. We'll need legal signoff for any numbers.
Ying Li: I can take the co-marketing/ legal touchpoint. We'll need AMX to sign an exec approval for any public perf/W claims. Point them at our small audit form.
Maria Gomez: Action items: 1) Jake/OIiver to produce runbook draft with exact commands + telemetry keys (by EOD Thursday). 2) AMX to provide driver/firmware and a contact for power sensor wiring. 3) Partnerships (Susan/Ying) to draft marketplace checklist and co-marketing NDA addendum.
Oliver Chen: I'll start kernel sweep tomorrow. Need AMX kernel image or a container with driver stack. If they can't share, propose controlled lab access. I'll test: fused-attn, kv-evict policy, and aten kernel v2.3.
Jake Turner: I'll add sane default metrics to the harness: token/s, p50/p95 latency, power_avg, tok_per_joule, mem_headroom, gpu_util_perc. Also add a mode flag `--sustained` that ramps for 15m to capture thermal throttling.
Susan Park: Timeline suggestion — 2-week joint window for engineering runs, 1 week for legal/marketing signoff, then marketplace listing the week after. AMX ok with that? @amx-contact ? :calendar:
Ying Li: I'll circulate the co-marketing template and a checklist of required artifacts (raw logs, runbook, sensor calibration note).
Maria Gomez: OK — I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 10am PT with AMX eng + our bench leads. Agenda: runbook template, kernel ownership, sensor details, and timeline. Will drop calendar invite. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
